scope: Taipei’s historic Futai Street Mansion at 26 Yanping South Road, with its projecting stone arcade, timber upper level and three-dormer mansard, after the 2009 restoration.

review.notes: Qualla was checked first. Its CC0 candidate depicts the nearby Ningxia Night Market, and the direct mansion photographs have attribution licenses. The Ministry archive color study has a CC0 object record and an unidentified underlying photograph. Architectural geometry follows the municipal descriptions and original map.
